steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Enter the ruins beneath the Wizards' Tower.
Pass through the two doors in the ruins and talk to Ariane.

actions.text: What do you need help with?
I'd be happy to help.

steps.text: [Accept Quest]

actions.text: How can I get you out?
Okay, what do you want me to do?

steps.text: Use the prepared fire rune on a red vortex and the prepared air rune on a grey vortex.
Talk to Ariane.

actions.text: OK, I'll do that now.

steps.title: Memories
steps.text: Head through the eastern library door.
Put the glowing fire rune on the red chair and the glowing air rune on the grey chair.
Head west back through the door.
Talk to Ariane.

actions.text: I saw them talking about the 'teleportation problem'.
So, what now?

steps.title: The meeting of the head wizards
steps.text: Use each prepared rune on a vortex corresponding to the colour of the background of the rune.
Talk to Ariane.

actions.text: OK, I'll do that now.

steps.text:
Head west and climb up the staircase to go back to the room with the rune guardian.
  • Use the glowing cosmic rune with the Grey Order statue (north-west).
  • Use the glowing nature rune with the Green Order statue (north-east).
  • Use the glowing law rune with the Blue Order statue (south-east).
  • Use the glowing chaos rune with the Red Order statue (south-west).
Return to the main chamber and talk to Ariane.

actions.text: The Green master stole the Red apprentice's idea!
Okay, so what do we do now?
OK.

steps.title: Memories of the Abyss
steps.text: Head through the northern studies door.

Head into the north-eastern room.
  • Use the glowing chaos rune on the large chair.
  • Use the glowing fire rune on the middle chair.
Return to the main chamber and talk to Ariane.

actions.text: The Red master summoned a demon!
So what do we do now?
OK.

steps.title: The teleportation debate
steps.text: Head through the eastern library door.

Use Glowing Runes in the following order:
  • Use the glowing air rune on the grey chair
  • Use the glowing fire rune on the red chair
  • Use the glowing earth rune on the green chair
  • Use the glowing water rune on the blue chair
  • Use the glowing chaos rune on the table.
Return to the main chamber and talk to Ariane.

actions.text: The wizards were about to start the ritual.
OK, what now?
OK.

steps.text: Head through the eastern library door.

Search the shelves for
  • Document fragment (1/5)
  • Document fragment (3/5)
Return to the main chamber.
Head through the northern studies door.

Search the crates and chests in each room for
  • Document fragment (2/5)
  • Document fragment (4/5)
  • Document fragment (5/5)
  • Diary
Once you have found all of the document fragments (5 in total) head back to the main chamber.
Talk to Ariane. (Do this before placing the runes or it will not trigger the cutscene.)

actions.text: I found some document fragments.
I found a diary in the ruins.
Enough about the diary.
OK.

steps.title: The beam
steps.text:
Place the Runes in their corresponding positions on the floor surrounding the blue beam: If the cutscene doesn't trigger, the placement is incorrect. Try picking up one of the runes and placing it down again in the same spot.
  • North: Law
  • North-east: Fire
  • East: Nature
  • South-east: Air
  • South: Chaos
  • South-west: Water
  • West: Cosmic
  • North-west: Earth

Head west and climb up the staircase to go back to the surface.
  • Alternately use the wicked hood teleport and descend to the bottom floor.
Talk to Wizard Ellaron who is now at the entrance to the Wizards' Tower.

actions.text: Ariane is hurt in the ruins of the old Tower!
I didn't say she was in a coma.
Enough talk! Prepare to fight, Red Wizard!

steps.title: The burning tower
steps.text: Talk to Ariane.

Use the following prepared runes on Ariane corresponding to the beam Must be completed in order from top to bottom:
  • Cosmic rune - Thick (spinning) grey beam
  • Water rune - Simple blue beam

Ascend the beam
  • Earth rune - Simple green beam
  • Fire rune - Simple red beam

Ascend the beam
  • Law rune - Thick (spinning) blue beam
  • Nature rune - Thick (spinning) green beam

Ascend the beam
  • Chaos rune - Thick (spinning) red beam
  • Air rune - Simple grey beam
Talk to Ariane.

actions.text: Are you OK?
So... what now?
So, is there a reward?
We did find out what happened to the old tower.

steps.text: Quest complete!
